decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits transfer semantics to replacement-contract NFTs and records that legacy NFTs and transfers are excluded from active-system benefits; no additional update or removal is required.

The existing message-539 MODIFY already records the restarted token sequence, replacement-contract-only referral identity, and exclusion of old-contract referral codes; no additional change is required.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts random commission recipients to owners of replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract NFT owners; no additional change is required.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes Transak-created mints to the active replacement contract, fully capturing the necessary effect of abandoning the old contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes ETH wallet mints to the active replacement contract, so no additional update or attribute removal is required.
